universe_definition: At each quarter end, use the latest accepted 10-K/10-Q submission strictly before the decision time. Include a CIK only when that filing's as-filed SIC belongs to a declared technology/energy group, its as-filed SEC status is Large Accelerated or Accelerated, and the filing is no more than 450 days old.
limitations: SEC SIC ranges are a transparent sector approximation, not historical GICS classifications.
Filer status is an investability proxy, not a point-in-time market-cap or liquidity screen.
A current SEC ticker match does not establish the ticker that traded historically.
A delisting-aware return series is required before this universe can authorize strategy claims.
